text: Add ToS disclaimer for cloud AI training: Training on Claude GPT-4 outputs may violate provider Terms of Service and raise copyright questions for derivative works
Document fair use arguments for AI training on cloud outputs: transformative use, research purpose, no commercial redistribution of base model outputs
Implement confidence scores for pattern detection to reduce false positives in shadow analysis
Allow deferred training scheduling instead of fixed 03:00 for hardware flexibility
Document what degrades without Pi Dream session continuity for memory-agnostic design transparency
Add data retention policies for shadow data with automatic purge after N days
Implement user control over training inclusion with opt-in per category
Create export capabilities for adapter weights and training data portability
Add fallback when Ollama unavailable: pure CPU inference via llama.cpp direct
Document backup strategy for LoRA adapter weights: versioned checkpoints to ProtonDrive
